review: Source-only pinned audit. No 3DS build, no independent 3DS performance capture and no code imported into Strikers.
architecture: Native recreation with Kinoko physics and dedicated rendering/audio/menu implementation; not a drop-in original GX frontend replacement.
fps_claim: README states New 3DS 60 FPS 2D / 30 FPS stereo, Old 3DS 30 FPS. This does not establish a Strikers Vita result.
licensing: LICENSE covers continuation changes only; NOTICE says original imported dudewhat port has no explicit license. Use independently implemented ideas; direct copying needs per-file provenance.

findings.idea: Prepared native model and material records
findings.behavior: Writes little-endian GMDL vertex/index/submesh records, deduplicates full vertex bytes and merges only consecutive equivalent material records. GPU-ready 3DS textures are cooked separately.
findings.port: Extend Strikers prepared resources to lit indexed-PN Characters before GLX/GX setup. Static AVNR geometry alone already exists.

findings.behavior: sameMaterial compares flags, lighting, constant/add/ambient, extended state and texture indices; excludes overrides and material callbacks. Skips repeated material setup without automatically merging the draws.
findings.port: Prepare a Strikers material contract and preserve EFB/clear/copy/barrier and BeginScene invalidation. Raster-only uniform invalidation is a smaller independently testable patch.

findings.idea: Native palette commands and immutable frame parameters
findings.behavior: Double-buffered render command lists copy transforms and palette affine rows; one consumer owns Citro3D; deferred CPU writes wait for the proper GPU boundary.
findings.port: Typed prepared draw with mesh/material handles and current palette snapshot in the existing ordered consumer queue. Avoid GX matrix serialize/parse only for covered families.

findings.behavior: Converts bind positions once and puts matrix index*3 in normal.x; refuses animated normals and more than 19 matrices. PICA shader skinned branch reads positions, not normals.
findings.port: Cannot use this vertex representation unchanged for pointlit Characters. Vita contract must keep PN selection, normal palette, lighting and texgen. Existing GXM GPU transforms do not eliminate frontend setup.

findings.behavior: At load, exact byte equality of position+normal+matrix selects the earliest vertex; only retains maps saving at least 25 percent transforms. SharedPositions separately deduplicates position+matrix for unlit work.
findings.port: Only optimize measured CPU-deformed/fallback work with full source dependencies; no expected benefit for already GPU-transformed resident draws.

findings.behavior: Precomputed bounds skip invisible contiguous index runs, preserve authored order, merge gaps to cap ranges at four per submesh. Can still multiply native draw count.
findings.port: Do not activate fine subdivision under a CPU submission bottleneck. Start with whole-packet conservative culling using bounds for the current pose/pass.

findings.idea: Reduced visual quality is separate from lossless optimization
findings.behavior: Old 3DS reduced mode disables shadow volumes, reduces bloom/effects and uses 4-tick animation steps.
findings.port: Not part of the accepted equivalent rendering optimization; separate optional quality mode only.

strikers_comparison.asset_format_difference: MKW converters parse BRRES/NW4R. Strikers native converter reads GLG chunks and explicitly excludes SKIN/VERTEX_ANIM. This is not a reusable Strikers parser.
strikers_comparison.already_present: Resident/native GXM geometry, indexed-PN GPU transforms, ordered async GX worker, immutable fixed-uniform publications. Native buffers do not bypass ordinary GLX/GX state preparation.
strikers_comparison.next_structural_target: A prepared Characters 3d_pointlit draw selected before avoidable GLX/GX setup, with persistent mesh/material identity, current position/normal palettes, view/lighting/texgen/fragment parameters and original FIFO slot fallback. Shadowed requires its own pass contract.
strikers_comparison.bounded_patch: gxm_raster_uniform_reuse default OFF; BP 0x40/0x41 pipeline transitions advance Raster only. All other pipeline changes and contract transitions retain full uniform rebuilds. No MKW code imported.

bounded_patch_hardware.decision: No promotion, default OFF; one matched quiet pair shows no FPS improvement
